rounds.note: Here's your Lizard Mage! A purple robe with silver trim, a black mask over just his mouth, yellow lizard eyes, a spiky purple crest, a tail, and a tall black staff with a glowing purple orb. In the attack picture he raises the staff to cast a spell. I made his scales green. Want them a different color? Tap Change it and tell me!

Here he is with a purple hood with silver trim, and his neck is shorter (but not too short). A couple of his crest spikes poke out of the back of the hood. Everything else stayed the same. What do you think?

Round 3! No more bonnet: now it's a pointy wizard hood that falls over his shoulders like a little cape. The mask was there before but hard to see, so I made it bigger: black cloth over his mouth with a silver band and rivets. Neck stays the same. What do you think?
Round 4: I moved the hood back so his yellow eyes show, and made the inside of the hood black like a shadow. Try 🎨 Tweak it yourself too, to change his colors or size!
